feed_title: Orthopaedic Memory Foam Bolster Dog Bed, Small 55 x 40cm to Large 70 x 55cm, Non Slip Base, 30C Washable Cover | PawLunova Chatsworth
descriptionHtml:
Crumb memory foam. Bolster walls. Our lowest price for a proper base.

Chatsworth is a memory foam bolster dog bed in Small 55 × 40cm, Medium 65 × 45cm and Large 70 × 55cm. The zipped covers machine wash at 30°C.

Most owners have quietly accepted that a dog bed lasts 18 months. You pay £40, it feels generous in the shop, and by spring it has packed into two ridges with a dip down the middle. So you buy another.

A crumb memory foam base breaks that. It moulds around them as they settle, where polyester migrates to the edges and stays.

What they get

  • A crumb memory foam base: It moulds as they settle, where polyester packs into ridges.
  • Cushioned bolster walls: An edge to lean on for a dog who avoids open space.
  • A non-slip base: It stays put on wood, laminate and tiles.
  • Sleeping areas we publish: 38 × 27cm, 45 × 35cm and 50 × 45cm.

Best for: A first proper bed, a spare for upstairs, or replacing one gone flat. The cheapest bed we make.

Why it is worth the money

The Large is £79. Replace a £40 bed yearly and you pass that inside three years, your dog on flattened filling throughout. The foam core carries a 5-year no-flatten guarantee under normal domestic use. You have 100 nights to check. If they do not take to it, we collect free from the UK mainland and refund in full.

Here is the limit. The Large is 70 × 55cm outside, 50 × 45cm inside. A labrador hangs off the end, and we would rather say so.

Size and fit

SizeOutside (cm)Sleeping area (cm)
Small55 × 40 × 2238 × 27
Medium65 × 45 × 2545 × 35
Large70 × 55 × 2850 × 45

Go by the sleeping area, not the outside. Measure your dog curled, and size up if you are between. For a labrador or larger, see our XL beds. Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly which one to take.

Everyday care

Remove the zipped covers and machine wash at 30°C. Air-dry before refitting. Do not tumble dry, and never wash or soak the foam.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide. 5 years on the foam.

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. The foam core also has a 5-year no-flatten guarantee under normal domestic use, subject to the guarantee terms; cover wear and pet damage are not included. Read the full returns and guarantee terms. This guarantee is in addition to your statutory rights and does not affect them.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

The questions we get asked most.

Which of the three sizes?

Work from the sleeping area, not the outside.

How much is postage?

Free above £40, which every size here clears.

Can I pay in instalments?

Yes. Choices show when you check out.

Is crumb foam the same as a slab?

No. Memory foam in crumb form, which holds the price down.

Would it suit a dog getting on in years?

We describe, we do not promise. Crumb foam, bolster walls, 22 to 28cm deep. Ask your vet.

Can I actually wash it?

Yes, at 30°C. No tumble dryer, no water on the foam.

And if they refuse it?

It goes back inside the 100 nights, at our cost.

Pick the sleeping area that fits them and stop buying flat beds.
